key_point: Why Max Payne has a familiar face
title: Why Max Payne has a familiar face
caption: Max Payne's face belongs to Sam Lake, the game's own writer. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #maxpayne #remedy

instagram.caption:
Max Payne's face is not a model or a hired actor. It is Sam Lake, the writer of the game.

Remedy was a small studio in Finland with a tight budget, so Lake stood in front of the camera himself and his photos became Max.

His famous constipated squint became one of gaming's best memes, and Lake still jokes about it today.

Did you know the writer was the face?
